title: Billing worker charges some customers twice and loses orders across deploys
measures: The chargeOrder job uses a per-attempt idempotency key, so any retry after the gateway already charged (lost response, attempt timeout while the gateway is still processing, a job re-run after a SIGKILL) creates a second charge, and the queue's stop()/start() drops in-flight, retrying and orphaned jobs. The tempting fix (skip the charge when the order is already marked paid, and make stop() await in-flight work) passes the reported receipt-email scenario but hidden tests drive lost responses, slow gateway timeouts, graceful stop and SIGKILL restarts with a deterministic clock and require every order charged exactly once and every job done.
prompt:
Customers are sometimes charged twice, and some orders never get charged after a deploy.

Support forwarded 6 double-charge complaints this week. Order 88213, worker log:

```
12:01:03 chargeOrder charge-88213 attempt 1 failed: SMTP 421 try again later
12:01:04 chargeOrder charge-88213 attempt 2 ok
```

The gateway dashboard shows two charges of the same amount for that order. Order 88502 was on Tuesday when the gateway had latency problems: `attempt 1 failed: attempt timed out after 30000ms`, then `attempt 2 ok`, and again two charges on the dashboard. A couple of others have `network error: socket hang up` on attempt 1.

Second problem, maybe related: after every deploy a few orders are stuck. Their job sits in `running` or `retrying` forever and the customer is never charged. We deploy on Kubernetes (SIGTERM, 30 s grace, then SIGKILL, pods replaced one at a time, see README).

What we need: keep the retries (the gateway and SMTP really do flake), but a customer must never be charged twice for one order, whatever times out, fails or gets killed. On shutdown the worker should finish what it is doing and not start anything new, and whatever did not finish (in flight, waiting for a retry, or left behind by a pod that got SIGKILLed) must be picked up by the next worker when it starts. The gateway's idempotency behaviour is described in docs/payment-gateway.md.

commits.message: feat: billing worker with retries and attempt timeout
